Hi Samantha / Mark —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about FinServe's latency/throughput targets for the document ingestion pipeline. Quick recap and next steps so we all have the same view: 

- Pilot scope: 3 models (chat + reranking + embeddings) across 2 production endpoints.
- Success metric: end-to-end latency <= 250ms P95 for chat baseline and embedding throughput of ~60 reqs/min.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target week of 6/14; production evaluation in July.

Next steps (owner):
1) Camila: send vendor setup packet + invoice template — attached.
2) FinServe procurement: add Redwood as a vendor, send portal invite and W-9/ACH instructions to accounts-payable@redwood.com.
3) Once procurement confirms, Marissa (CS) will schedule a kickoff onboarding session.

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.pdf (invoice template, net-30 default)

If anything above looks off, tell me — otherwise can you confirm who on procurement will own the vendor setup and an expected date for the portal invite?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
